sampling.selection: fixed evenly spaced source-frame indices chosen before statistics

frozen_old_mpr.old_contract: normalize every raw pixel token before MPR and retain the mean-resultant norm
frozen_old_mpr.consequence: The persisted feature norm is directional agreement in [0,1], not the observed RADIO raw amplitude near 31.

interpretation.main_scale_mismatch: The old normalized MPR sends a norm below or near one to a frozen nonlinear adaptor trained on raw RADIO tokens whose norm is about 31, confounding adaptor calibration with view agreement.
interpretation.relation_to_existing_dynamic_range_audit: The independently frozen SPIn ladder found that adaptor-after-normalized-raw-MPR collapses primitive probability standard deviation by about 202 times.
interpretation.decision: Proceed with a versioned factorized MPR that restores responsibility-weighted raw log-amplitude while storing view-directional resultant separately. Do not mutate canonical-mpr-v1.
